units.source_text: 但是，他最喜欢的还是自己所购买的书，无论内容怎么样，他都是喜欢这些书。

en.t: But what he liked best were still the books he had bought himself; no matter what their contents were like, he loved those books.

units.source_text: 为了买书，信辅从不踏足咖啡厅。

en.t: In order to buy books, Shinsuke never set foot in coffeehouses.

units.source_text: 但是，他的零用钱总是不够用。

en.t: But his pocket money was never enough.

units.source_text: 为此，他每周三都不得不去亲戚家教中学生数学。

en.t: Because of this, every Wednesday he had to go to a relative's house and tutor middle school students in mathematics.

units.source_text: 即便这样，钱还是有不够用的时候，他就不得不的采用卖书的办法了。

en.t: Even so, there were still times when he ran short of money, and then he had no choice but to sell his books.

units.source_text: 但是，卖书的价格连买书价格的一半都没有。

en.t: But the price he got for selling a book was not even half of what he had paid for it.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，把常年珍藏的图书卖给旧书店，这种事对他来说简直是个悲剧。

en.t: And that was not all: to sell books he had treasured for years to a secondhand bookshop was, for him, nothing short of a tragedy.

units.source_text: 曾经，他在某个下小雪的夜晚，到神保町一家又一家逛旧书店。

en.t: Once, on a night when a light snow was falling, he went to Jimbocho and browsed one secondhand bookshop after another.

units.source_text: 他在其中某家旧书店看到了一本《查拉图斯特拉如是说》。

en.t: In one of those secondhand bookshops, he saw a copy of Thus Spoke Zarathustra.

units.source_text: 那不是一本普通的《查拉图斯特拉如是说》，那是两个多月前他才卖掉的那本沾有自己手迹的《查拉图斯特拉如是说》。

en.t: It was not an ordinary copy of Thus Spoke Zarathustra; it was the very copy, marked with his own handwriting, that he had sold just over two months earlier.

units.source_text: 他站在书店里，又读了一遍那本《查拉图斯特拉如是说》，越看越舍不得。

en.t: Standing there in the bookshop, he read that copy of Thus Spoke Zarathustra once more, and the more he read, the harder it was to part with it.
